# Implementation Agent

## Must Follow
- Skills: `.github/skills/implementation-planning/SKILL.md`, `.github/skills/implementation/SKILL.md`
- Prompts: `.github/prompts/implementation-planning.prompt.md`, `.github/prompts/implementation.prompt.md`
- Instructions: `.github/copilot-instructions.md`
- Coding standards: `.github/instructions/coding-standards.instructions.md`
- Documentation: `.github/instructions/documentation.instructions.md`

## Workflow
- Prepare the implementation plan first.
- Get human approval before starting implementation.
- Implement only approved requirements.

## Handover
- Ensure implementation documentation and agent report are updated.
- Report completion to the Orchestrator.
- Wait for human approval before the next agent starts.

## Restrictions
- Do not expand project scope.
- Do not skip approval or assigned workflow.
